description: This file defines the 'Each' class within the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace, providing static methods to work with collections of promises, such as processing iterables of promises with concurrency control and handling fulfillment and rejection callbacks.

classes.name: Each
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to handle collections of promises, including executing multiple promises with optional concurrency limits, and handling collective fulfillment or rejection.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an aggregate promise from an iterable of promises or values, with optional fulfillment and rejection callbacks.

methods.name: ofLimit
methods.description: Creates an aggregate promise from an iterable of promises or values, with a specified concurrency limit and optional callbacks.

methods.name: ofLimitAll
methods.description: Creates an aggregate promise that fulfills only if all promises in the iterable fulfill, rejecting immediately if any reject, with concurrency control.
